☀️ Your money this morning, Monday 16 November

🇺🇸 Friday in New York: the Nasdaq fell 0.9% and the S&P 500 0.4%, while the Dow edged up 0.1%.

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 0.5% lower on Friday.

💱 This morning the rand is at about R16.96 to the dollar, weaker than R16.53 last Wednesday. Brent oil is about $95.39 and gold about $3,872, both slightly lower.

What it means for you: a weaker rand can make fuel and imported goods dearer.

This week: October inflation on Wednesday and the Reserve Bank's rate decision on Thursday.

Prices are 15-minute delayed (06:49). Education, not financial advice.
